name: falsifiable
description: A Claude Code plugin where every promise an agent makes is a check that can fail.
author: Vladyslav Yefimenko

scripts.check:example: node scripts/config.mjs --check examples/notes-app && node scripts/check-rules.mjs examples/notes-app && npm --prefix examples/notes-app test
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate --strict .claude-plugin/plugin.json && claude plugin validate --strict .
scripts.check: npm test && npm run check:rules && npm run check:example
